map.marketing-roi：在线输入参数即可即时得到结果，无需安装与注册。: marketing-roi: enter parameters online and get results instantly, no installation or registration needed.
map.一次全域营销后，核算整体投入产出与净利率。: After a full-funnel campaign, work out the overall input-output and net margin.
map.单条广告投放，用广告收入与广告费算 ROAS/ROI。: For a single ad placement, compute ROAS/ROI from ad revenue and ad spend.
map.叠加复购，评估客户长期价值是否被低估。: Layer repeat purchases on top to assess whether customer lifetime value is being understated.
map.：营销投入 50000、客单价 200、曝光 100000、点击率 5% → 点: : marketing spend 50,000, order value 200, 100,000 impressions, 5% CTR -> 5,000 clicks; 3% conversion -> 150 conversions; 20% repeat rate -> 30 repeats; total revenue = (150 + 30) x 200 = 36,000, ROI = (36000 - 50000)/50000 = -28% (the first order loses money, recovered through repeat purchases).
map.：广告投入 20000、广告收入 80000 → 广告 ROAS=4.0、广告: : ad spend 20,000, ad revenue 80,000 -> ad ROAS = 4.0, ad ROI = 300%; after splitting from the overall basis, you can judge the separate contributions of organic and paid traffic.
map.ROI 扣成本看真实盈利（净利/投入），ROAS 只看收入/广告费；ROI 为负: ROI deducts costs to show real profit (net profit / investment), while ROAS only looks at revenue / ad spend; ROI can be negative while ROAS is still above 1, so read both together.
map.复购率为什么要计入？: Why include the repeat purchase rate?
map.首单常亏损，盈利来自复购。把复购量按客单价计入收入，才能反映客户长期价值，避免过: The first order is often loss-making and profit comes from repeat purchases. Fold repeat volume into revenue at the order value to reflect long-term customer value, avoiding cutting good acquisition channels too early.
